title: Deconstructing the CSS Box Model
ques: Explain the four concentric layers of the **CSS Box Model**: **Content**, **Padding**, **Border**, and **Margin**. Write a CSS rule demonstrating all four layers.
explanation: Every HTML element is rendered as a rectangular box consisting of inner content, surrounding padding, an enclosing border, and an outer margin establishing distance from neighbors.

title: Content-Box vs Border-Box Sizing
ques: Explain why **`box-sizing: border-box`** is preferred over the default `content-box`. Provide calculations showing how the total rendered element width differs under each setting.

answer.content:
### Total Rendered Width Calculation Comparison:
Given: `width: 200px; padding: 20px; border: 5px solid black;`

* **`box-sizing: content-box` (Browser Default):**
  * The declared `width` applies ONLY to content.
  * `Total Rendered Width = width + left_padding + right_padding + left_border + right_border`
  * `Total Width = 200px + 20px + 20px + 5px + 5px = 250px`
  * Adding padding causes the element to unexpectedly expand and break grid layouts!

* **`box-sizing: border-box` (Modern Standard):**
  * The declared `width` encompasses content + padding + border.
  * `Total Rendered Width = 200px`
  * The browser automatically shrinks the inner content area (`200 - 40 - 10 = 150px`) so the element never exceeds its declared 200px boundary.

### Universal Reset Recommendation:
```css
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
```

explanation: `border-box` ensures declared dimensions remain constant regardless of padding or border adjustments, making responsive layouts predictable and stable.

title: Margin Collapse Mechanics
ques: Explain the phenomenon of **Margin Collapsing** in vertical block layouts. Provide a CSS code example showing what happens when two adjacent paragraphs have top and bottom margins.
explanation: Vertical margins between adjacent sibling block elements collapse into a single margin equal to the largest of the individual margins, rather than accumulating.

title: Centering Blocks with Auto Margins
ques: Demonstrate how setting horizontal margins to **`auto`** (`margin: 0 auto;`) centers a block element inside its parent container.
explanation: When an element has an explicit width, setting `margin-left: auto` and `margin-right: auto` causes the browser to divide the remaining space equally, centering the element horizontally.
